results.title: NPL set to kick off with bigger stars and Rs1.5 billion in sight
results.content: The third season brings bigger international stars, a new DRS system, and increased prize money as the T20 franchise league expands its commercial ambitions.

results.title: In the Buddha’s birthplace, a famous nun’s appointment draws fire
results.content: Protesters want Ani Choying Drolma’s selection as head of Lumbini’s development trust annulled over questions about her money and her citizenship. She says every question has been answered. The record is less certain.

results.title: Four ways US foreign policy could change if Democrats win in November
results.content: Trump has also ​withheld or cancelled billions of dollars in foreign aid approved by Congress. Many Democrats have been angered by the cuts and say they will try to restore ​funding.

results.title: Three dead, three missing in motorboat accident in eastern Nepal
results.content: The boat was carrying 15 passengers and its operator from Bhojpur to Chatara when it crashed in Dhankuta district on Sunday afternoon, reportedly after its brakes failed.

results.title: Kathmandu Police spokesperson says security arrangements for this NPL will be stronger and more dependable
results.content: Superintendent of Police Dan Bahadur Thapa explains the security plan, the technology behind it and the police’s fight against illegal betting.

results.title: RSP panel to examine audio as Khagendra Sunar denies allegations of violence against woman
results.content: The lawmaker has alleged a conspiracy against him, prompting the party’s disciplinary committee to seek further evidence and consider technical analysis of the recording attributed to him.

results.title: Bay of Bengal cyclone to bring rain and snow to Nepal from Thursday night
results.content: The weather system is expected to affect much of Nepal through Saturday, raising concerns for farmers preparing to harvest paddy and trekkers heading to the Himalayas.

results.title: How Ukraine’s strikes on Russian energy sites deepened the rift with Trump
results.content: Diesel prices have hit record highs since the US and Israel launched a ​war against Iran in February, and global energy costs spiked.

results.title: NPL Season 3 winner to receive Rs15 million as prize money rises
results.content: CAN expects the tournament’s gross revenue to reach Rs1.5 billion, driven by sponsorships, ticket sales and broadcasting.

results.title: Chitwan farmers face a race against rain and wild elephants
results.content: Rain forecasts are delaying the harvest in Madi, but waiting leaves ripe paddy vulnerable to elephant raids.

results.title: Tourism resumes in Manaslu after Budhi Gandaki floods
results.content: A total of 116 tourists entered the Manaslu Conservation Area in a week after flood damage disrupted trekking routes, but access to the Tsum Valley remains blocked.

results.title: Who pays for Nepal’s informal workers’ security?
results.content: Nearly nine in ten Nepali workers are informal, yet the system built to protect them barely reaches them. Registration alone won’t fix that.

results.title: Can police make you unlock your phone?
results.content: Seizing a device, searching it and demanding its password are three different acts. Nepal’s laws and police procedures should treat them that way.

results.title: Nepal resumes power exports to Bangladesh after flood disruption
results.content: Nepal has restarted its 40MW electricity supply through India’s transmission network, using Solu Khola and Kabeli B1 to replace the flood-damaged Trishuli and Chilime hydropower plants.

results.title: From induction cookers to bank records, Nepalis find ways to use AI
results.content: A municipal official uses ChatGPT to handle household and office tasks, a ride-hailing driver creates social media videos, and a bank employee cuts hours off data checks with AI tools.

results.title: Violence flares in Paris after largely peaceful protests across France
results.content: Despite largely peaceful rallies against rising living costs and inequality, clashes erupted in Paris and other French cities, prompting a massive security deployment.

results.title: Will Nepal’s lights stay on at 7pm in the winter?
results.content: The Bhotekoshi flood and the Kaligandaki landslides exposed a grid that depends on a few valleys and on river flow. Winter evenings, when demand peaks and India’s imports stop, will show how much of Nepal’s power is dependable.

results.title: Inside the colourful world of Durga Puja
results.content: Photojournalist Bikas Rauniar captures the elaborate pandals and artistic displays that define the festival in Kolkata and Guwahati.

results.title: Sudurpaschim spends millions to fight child marriage, yet the practice persists
results.content: The province has spent Rs12.87 million on prevention programmes in five years, but has never assessed their impact.

results.title: PHP2Shell security flaw forces thousands of Nepali websites offline
results.content: Government portals, Nepal Rastra Bank’s website and some digital services have been suspended as a precaution after two critical vulnerabilities were discovered in PHP.

results.title: NPL returns with bigger ambitions and global recognition
results.content: The third season begins in Kirtipur on Monday with ICC recognition, DRS technology and greater scope for international players.

results.title: Houthi attacks raise safety fears among Nepali workers in Saudi Arabia
results.content: Around 400,000 Nepalis work in Saudi Arabia. Recent attacks have raised fresh concerns about their safety as workers call for better protection and emergency arrangements.

results.title: Nepal opens door to private power traders, but legal hurdles remain
results.content: The energy ministry has initiated the process of amending the Electricity Act, with a bill forwarded to the law ministry.

results.title: PHP Foundation ‘under-funded’ with one full-time staff member, director says
results.content: Artificial intelligence has proved both a help and a burden to the foundation.

results.title: Two Japanese climbers found dead on Gangapurna
results.content: Hidesuke Taneishi, 40, and Tetsu Hashimoto, 25, went missing at around 7,050 metres while climbing the 7,455-metre peak in Manang.

results.title: Nepali Congress falls short of one-third women’s quota in central committee
results.content: All 69 women elected to the central committee won reserved or inclusion-category seats, leaving party president Gagan Thapa to nominate at least 30 more to meet the requirement.

results.title: Bay of Bengal cyclone could bring rain, snow to Nepal next week
results.content: The weather system may affect Nepal from October 28 to November 1, prompting warnings for farmers to protect paddy crops and trekkers to exercise caution in the high Himalayas.

results.title: A look at the Prithvi Highway as Dashain draws to a close
results.content: Vehicles carry people returning to Kathmandu after the Dashain break, while others travel to visit relatives after receiving tika and blessings.

results.title: Bhandari calls for long-term climate support for vulnerable countries
results.content: Nepal’s former president Bidya Devi Bhandari urges Himalayan nations to cooperate on glacier monitoring and disaster preparedness, while calling for long-term international support for climate-vulnerable countries.

results.title: Rutherford, Hossain join NPL teams ahead of new season
results.content: West Indies batter Sherfane Rutherford joins Sudurpaschim Royals after scoring 291 runs for Gujarat Titans in the 2025 IPL, while Bangladesh all-rounder Shamim Hossain signs for Lumbini Lions.

results.title: Seven killed as gunmen open fire at church in Jordan in 'terrorist' attack, authorities say
results.content: Authorities blame extremists for the shooting during a funeral at a church in Karak, which also left 40 people wounded.

results.title: Modern night bus service begins between Jajarkot and Kathmandu
results.content: Six buses are operating on the route, with fares set at Rs3,500 against the government rate of Rs4,066.

results.title: Road accidents in Kathmandu Valley fall during Dashain
results.content: The number of crashes fell from 155 last year to 105 this year, while fatalities dropped from 10 to three, according to traffic police.

results.title: Ambani's Jio becomes most subscribed Indian IPO with $77 billion in bids
results.content: The offering surpasses the 2008 Reliance Power IPO, attracting more than 13.8 million applications and drawing strong demand from institutional and retail investors.

results.title: David Miller joins Karnali Yaks for third NPL season
results.content: The South African left-hander, a key player in Gujarat Titans’ 2022 IPL title win, brings extensive international and franchise T20 experience to Karnali’s squad.

results.title: Europe’s deadliest summer in 26 years leaves 50,000 dead, study estimates
results.content: Scientists estimate that fossil fuel-driven climate change contributed to about two-thirds of heat-related deaths across 854 cities in 30 European countries.

results.title: Dashain brings fewer domestic tourists to Sauraha
results.content: Hoteliers say fears of renewed road closures have kept visitors away, although international tourists are gradually returning after flood-related cancellations.

results.title: Kathmandu’s streets are filling up as Dashain winds down
results.content: People are beginning to return to the Valley ahead of Dashain’s formal conclusion at Purnima, bringing more vehicles and pedestrians back onto the roads.

results.title: Rabi Lamichhane says India visit is personal, not political
results.content: The RSP chair says he is travelling to fulfil a vow he made in prison, with visits planned to temples in Uttarakhand and Assam.

results.title: They never fought in the decade-long ‘People’s War’. They still bear its scars
results.content: Civilians injured or disabled during the conflict, despite having no affiliation with either side, say the state has excluded them from relief and compensation programmes.
